name: FatoriPay Gateway for WooCommerce
author: suportepress

sections.description:
FatoriPay Gateway for WooCommerce integrates seamlessly with your store to process payments through Pix (instant payments), Boleto bancário, and Credit Cards. Designed for the Brazilian market, this official plugin ensures compliance with local regulations while providing a smooth checkout experience.

Key features:
– Pix payments: Instant payments with automatic order confirmation.
– Boleto bancário: Generate printable/sendable invoices.
– Credit Card processing: Secure transactions via FatoriPay’s gateway.
– Sandbox mode: Test payments before going live.
– Order status sync: Automatic updates for completed/failed payments.

Short Description

Accept Pix, Boleto, and Credit Card payments in WooCommerce via FatoriPay’s secure Brazilian payment gateway.

External Services

This plugin connects to the external service FatoriPay to process payments.

Required services and credentials:
– An active merchant account with FatoriPay: https://fatoripay.com.br
– API credentials, obtained from your FatoriPay dashboard
– API endpoints used:
– Production: https://api.fatoripay.com.br/api/v1/
– Sandbox (homologation): https://sandbox-api.fatoripay.com.br/api/v1/

Terms and Privacy Policy:
– Terms of Use: https://fatoripay.com.br/termosdeuso/
– Privacy Policy: https://fatoripay.com.br/avisodeprivacidade/

Data sent to FatoriPay:
– Order total
– Customer CPF or CNPJ (for Pix/Boleto)
– Selected payment method

This data is required for completing payment transactions through the FatoriPay gateway.

The plugin uses the WordPress HTTP API to securely send requests to FatoriPay’s servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin under Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Configure your API keys in WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > FatoriPay.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support Pix?

Yes, with automatic order confirmation when Pix payments are completed.

Is my customers’ data secure?

All transactions are processed by FatoriPay’s PCI-compliant servers—no sensitive data is stored on your website.

Can I test payments before going live?

Yes, enable Sandbox Mode in the plugin settings to simulate transactions.
